schema.help: Think only of traffic: vehicles, their speed and the crossings.
schema.text: How safe from traffic did you feel on this trip?

ar.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: إلى أي مدى شعرت بالأمان من حركة المرور في هذه الرحلة؟
ar.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: فكّر في حركة المرور فقط: المركبات وسرعتها وأماكن العبور.

de.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Wie sicher vor dem Verkehr haben Sie sich auf diesem Weg gefühlt?
de.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Denken Sie nur an den Verkehr: Fahrzeuge, ihr Tempo und die Überwege.

en.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: How safe from traffic did you feel on this trip?
en.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Think only of traffic: vehicles, their speed and the crossings.

fa.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: در این سفر چقدر خود را در برابر ترافیک در امان احساس کردید؟
fa.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: فقط به ترافیک فکر کنید: وسایل نقلیه، سرعتشان و محل‌های عبور.

fr.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: À quel point vous sentiez-vous en sécurité face à la circulation pendant ce trajet ?
fr.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Pensez seulement à la circulation : les véhicules, leur vitesse et les traversées de rue.

hu.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Mennyire érezte magát biztonságban a forgalomtól ezen az úton?
hu.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Csak a forgalomra gondoljon: a járművekre, a sebességükre és az átkelőkre.

it.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Quanto ti sentivi al sicuro dal traffico durante questo spostamento?
it.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Pensa solo al traffico: veicoli, velocità e attraversamenti.

tr.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Bu yolculukta kendinizi trafiğe karşı ne kadar güvende hissettiniz?
tr.#Think only of traffic: vehicles, their: Yalnızca trafiği düşünün: araçlar, hızları ve geçitler.
